ei.title: The Role of Moderation in a Healthy Diet
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Not too much or too little — that's what moderation means. Moderation does not mean that you have to eliminate low-nutrient-density foods from your diet, such as soft drinks and candy, but rather that you can include them occasionally. Moderation entails not taking anything to extremes. You probably have heard that vitamin C has positive effects, but that doesn't mean huge doses of this essential nutrient are appropriate for you. It's also important to remember that substances that are healthful in small amounts can sometimes be dangerous in large quantities. For example, the body needs zinc for hundreds of chemical reactions, including those that support normal growth, development, and immune function. Too much zinc, however, can cause deficiency of copper, another essential mineral, which can lead to damaged immune function. Being moderate in your diet means that you do not restrict or completely eliminate any one type of food, but rather that all types of food can fit into a healthful diet.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① preserve — occasionally — dangerous: (A) preserve(보존하다)는 eliminate(제거하다)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ② eliminate — constantly — dangerous: (B) constantly(항상)는 occasionally(가끔)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ eliminate — occasionally — beneficial: (C) beneficial(유익한)은 dangerous(위험한)의 반의어로 부적절
✅ ④ eliminate — occasionally — dangerous: 원문 일치. 저영양 식품을 식단에서 제거할(eliminate) 필요 없이 가끔(occasionally) 포함. 소량에서 건강에 좋은 물질이 대량에서 위험(dangerous)할 수 있다 ←정답
det.tip: eliminate low-nutrient-density foods / include them occasionally / dangerous in large quantities

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① extremes — appropriate — restrict: 원문 일치. 극단(extremes)으로 가져가지 않는 것이 절제이며, 큰 용량이 적절하지(appropriate) 않을 수 있고, 어떤 한 종류의 식품을 제한(restrict)하거나 완전히 제거하지 않는다 ←정답
❌ ② moderation — appropriate — restrict: (A) moderation(절제)은 extremes(극단)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ③ extremes — excessive — restrict: (B) excessive(과도한)는 appropriate(적절한)의 반의어로 부적절
❌ ④ extremes — appropriate — expand: (C) expand(확장하다)는 restrict(제한하다)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: not taking anything to extremes / appropriate for you / do not restrict

det.analysis:
❌ ① harmful — deficiency — moderate: (A) harmful(해로운)은 healthful(건강에 좋은)의 반의어로 부적절

❌ ④ beneficial: beneficial(유익한)은 healthful과 유사한 의미
det.tip: healthful(건강에 좋은) ↔ detrimental(해로운)

questions.passage:
(A) The restaurant prides itself on using only <u>moderate</u> amounts of salt and oil in its cooking, promoting healthier dining options for customers.
(B) Being <u>moderate</u> in your diet means that you do not restrict or completely eliminate any one type of food, but rather that all types of food can fit into a healthful diet.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 moderate의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: moderate: (A) 적당한 양의 소금과 기름 / (B) 식단에서 절제하는 태도
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 극단적인 — (B) 관대한: moderate의 의미와 무관한 선지
❌ ② (A) 적당한 — (B) 무관심한: (B)의 moderate는 무관심이 아닌 절제의 의미
❌ ③ (A) 보통의 — (B) 엄격한: (B)의 moderate는 엄격하지 않고 절제하는 의미
✅ ④ (A) 적당한 — (B) 절제하는: (A)는 적당한 양, (B)는 절제하는 태도 ←정답
det.tip: moderate: ① (형용사-양) 적당한 ② (형용사-태도) 절제하는, 온건한

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to remove or get rid of something completely"

det.analysis:
❌ ① moderate: moderate(절제하다)는 완전히 제거하는 것이 아님
❌ ② restrict: restrict(제한하다)는 완전히 제거하는 것이 아닌 부분적 제한
✅ ③ eliminate: eliminate(제거하다)는 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ entail: entail(수반하다)는 제거와 무관한 의미
det.tip: eliminate = remove completely = 완전히 제거하다. 본문: eliminate low-nutrient-density foods

questions.passage: It's also important to remember that substances that are healthful in small amounts can sometimes be __________ (danger) in large quantities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: danger(명사) → dangerous(형용사). be동사 뒤 보어 자리이므로 형용사형 dangerous가 필요.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: chemistry(명사) → chemical(형용사). reactions를 수식하는 형용사 자리이므로 chemical이 필요.
det.tip: hundreds of chemical reactions — 수백 가지 화학 반응. chemistry → chemical

questions.passage: Not too much or too little — that's what moderation means. Moderation does not mean that you have to eliminate low-nutrient-density foods from your diet, such as soft drinks and candy, but rather that you can include them occasionally. Moderation entails __________. You probably have heard that vitamin C has positive effects, but that doesn't mean huge doses of this essential nutrient are appropriate for you. It's also important to remember that substances that are healthful in small amounts can sometimes be dangerous in large quantities. For example, the body needs zinc for hundreds of chemical reactions, including those that support normal growth, development, and immune function. Too much zinc, however, can cause deficiency of copper, another essential mineral, which can lead to damaged immune function. Being moderate in your diet means that you do not restrict or completely eliminate any one type of food, but rather that all types of food can fit into a healthful diet.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:

✅ ② not taking anything to extremes: 원문 일치. 절제는 극단으로 가져가지 않는 것을 수반 ←정답
❌ ③ avoiding all processed food products: 모든 가공식품을 피하는 것은 극단적 행동
❌ ④ following a strict vegetarian diet: 엄격한 채식은 절제가 아닌 제한
det.tip: Moderation entails not taking anything to extremes — 절제는 극단을 피하는 것
